name: app-red-lit-ceo-quote-client-request-slide
title: Red-Lit CEO Quote Client Request
whatItIs: A dark red vignette slide with a small 'Client Request' label, a large white quote about traders needing simple data, a name and title, and a professional portrait lit in red at the right.
whatItMeans: A red-graded portrait keeps the photo on-brand and gives the quote authority.
techniques: Photo graded in the brand red
Large white quote left, portrait right
Quote mark as a simple double bar
Rounded frame edges with dark vignette

vocabulary.definition: A slide summarising what the client asked for.
Colour grading a photo to the brand palette.
